{07 14 00}I love redecorating because
it changes the way my room
feels so much!
{01 00 00 0a 00}{07 1b 00}{01 00 00 05 00}Sad breakups make a
place more beautiful{01 00 00 14 00} but
it's a high price to pay.

{07 1c 00}{01 00 00 0a 00}I dated a boy who was a
total furniture freak,
{01 00 00 0a 00}{04 02 00}.
{07 15 00}For some stupid reason, I'm
reminiscing about him.{01 00 00 05 00}
I have no idea why{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.
{01 00 00 0a 00}{07 1b 00}{01 00 00 05 00}I'm such an idiot{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 0a 00} Why
can't I just forget him and
his matching end tables?!

{07 0e 00}{01 00 00 0a 00}Your reflection at midnight
is what you'll look like in
ten years.
I read that somewhere. {07 02 00}But!{01 01 00}
{07 08 00}I don't want to know{01 00 00 05 00} what
I'll look like in ten years!

{07 14 00}He plays at the {ff 00 00 08}Roost {ff 00 00 00}every
Saturday!{01 00 00 0a 00}{07 13 00} Oh, he writes the
dreamiest songs!
{07 19 00}I think he's got a pretty
strong following, too,
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!{07 00 00}

{07 13 00}{01 00 00 0a 00}Take chairs.{01 01 00} I like 'em best
with armrests, {07 14 00}fancy
fabric, and gold fringe{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.
{07 0d 00}I want to sit in a chair{01 00 00 05 00},
no, a THRONE, like that
just once!

{07 0c 00}{01 00 00 0a 00}Take wardrobes, for
example.{01 00 00 14 00} {07 14 00}Or should I say
garment rooms?
{07 13 00}{01 00 00 0a 00}You see, right now all my
haute couture dresses are{01 00 00 0a 00}
crowding my house.
{07 00 00}Of course,{01 00 00 05 00} they're all gifts
from you-know-who,
{01 00 00 0a 00}{04 02 00}!

{07 0c 00}{01 00 00 0a 00}Take beds, for example.{01 01 00}
{01 00 00 0a 00}{07 1b 00}{01 00 00 05 00}Poorly made ones are flat
and have no support, right?
{07 00 00}I want to sleep{01 00 00 05 00}
in a bed that envelopes me
like a cloud, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.
{07 13 00}{01 00 00 0a 00}Like a bed for a queen,
{01 00 00 0a 00}{04 02 00}!

{07 14 00}Rather than looking at the
big picture,{01 00 00 0a 00} I focus on
individual pieces.
{07 13 00}{01 00 00 0a 00}That's one of the many
things{01 00 00 05 00} I love about myself.{01 00 00 0a 00}
My attention to detail!

{07 06 00}{0b 03 00}{04 1f 00}!{01 00 00 05 00} If you find 
some cool furniture, pick
some up for me, all right?
{07 00 00}I'm kidding!{01 00 00 05 00} I'm just
teasing, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}! I
mean, kind of.
{01 00 00 0a 00}{07 1b 00}In this world, {01 00 00 05 00}some people
want to nurture and others
want to BE nurtured.

{07 13 00}{01 00 00 0a 00}When you find the right
furniture, it feels like it
was just meant to be{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.
{07 19 00}Take my table, for example.
The first time I saw it, I
knew it was fate.
{07 15 00}Why don't relationships ever
turn out that way,
{04 02 00}?

When I picture my dream
chair, {07 13 00}{01 00 00 0a 00}I'm sitting in it and
sipping {04 13 00}{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}
{01 00 00 0a 00}{07 1b 00}{01 00 00 05 00}Visualization is very
important when buying
furniture, {01 00 00 0a 00}{04 02 00}.
